outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially lowered and open (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches its outer edge, then raises the door toward the oven front (frames 47–60, image and left_ego_image). The door is upright and closed by frame 61 and remains closed through frame 88 as the gripper withdraws (left_ego_image, corroborated by image and wrist_image). No failed attempt or unintended disturbance of nearby objects is visible.
